  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0176.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

org=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('N#CC1CC2CC(=O)N(C)C2C=C1'))
# The three solid wedges in the source are CN at C2, CH2 at C4,
# and N at C10.  Use right-handed, page x/y with z toward viewer.
coords=np.zeros((org.GetNumAtoms(),3))
page={2:(0,1,0),3:(.866,.5,0),4:(.866,-.5,0),10:(0,-1,0),11:(-.866,-.5,0),12:(-.866,.5,0),1:(0,2,1),0:(0,3,2),5:(1.65,-1,1),6:(1.2,-2,1),7:(1.8,-2.8,1),8:(0,-2,1),9:(-.3,-3,1)}
for i,p in page.items(): coords[i]=p
for i in [2,4,10]:
 h=[a.GetIdx() for a in org.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if a.GetAtomicNum()==1][0];coords[h]=coords[i]+np.array([0,0,-1.])
conf=Chem.Conformer(org.GetNumAtoms())
for i,p in enumerate(coords):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,p)
org.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(org)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(org,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('organic stereo SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(org)))
print('stereocenters',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(org,includeUnassigned=True))
org.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=176;params.numThreads=1
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(org,params)==0
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(org)
xyz=np.asarray(org.GetConformer().GetPositions())
center=(xyz[11]+xyz[12])/2
u=xyz[12]-xyz[11];u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
v=xyz[[2,3,4,10]].mean(axis=0)-center;v-=u*np.dot(u,v);v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
n=np.cross(v,u)
print('front nitrile / ring external',np.dot(xyz[1]-xyz[2],n),np.dot(xyz[5]-xyz[4],n),np.dot(xyz[8]-xyz[10],n))
# columns (front, alkene direction, in-ring direction); target n=x,u=y,v=-z
basis=np.array([n,u,v]).T
target=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1.]])
orgxyz=(xyz-center)@basis@target.T+np.array([2.15,0,0])

# Tp = hydridotris(pyrazol-1-yl)borate, bound through all three distal N atoms.
tp=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[BH-](n1nccc1)(n1nccc1)n1nccc1'))
params.randomSeed=2176
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(tp,params)==0
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(tp)
tpxyz=np.array(tp.GetConformer().GetPositions())
nd=np.array([2,7,12]); targets=np.array([[-2.20,0,0],[0,-2.20,0],[0,0,-2.20]])
a=tpxyz[nd]; ac=a.mean(0);bc=targets.mean(0)
U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((a-ac).T@(targets-bc));R=U@Vt
if np.linalg.det(R)<0:U[:,-1]*=-1;R=U@Vt
tpxyz=(tpxyz-ac)@R+bc
# If B starts on the open face, choose the other donor permutation by reflection.
if np.dot(tpxyz[0]-bc,np.array([-1.,-1.,-1.]))<0:
 tpxyz=(tpxyz-bc)@(np.eye(3)-2*np.outer(np.ones(3)/np.sqrt(3),np.ones(3)/np.sqrt(3)))+bc

p=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('P(C)(C)C'))
params.randomSeed=3176
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(p,params)==0
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(p)
pxyz=np.array(p.GetConformer().GetPositions());pxyz-=pxyz[0]
mvec=pxyz[[1,2,3]].mean(axis=0);mvec/=np.linalg.norm(mvec)
R,_=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([[0,0,1.]]),mvec.reshape(1,3))
pxyz=R.apply(pxyz)+np.array([0,0,2.5])

# Tetrapodal schematic: Tp down/left, P up/left, NO dashed up/right,
# and alkene solid wedge right. Check metal handedness before assembly.
def vol(pts):
 return np.linalg.det(np.array([pts[0]-pts[3],pts[1]-pts[3],pts[2]-pts[3]]))
page_points=np.array([[-1.,1,0],[-1,-1,0],[.5,1,-1],[1,0,1]]) # P,Tp,NO,alkene
model_points=np.array([[0,0,2.5],[-1,-1,-1],[0,1.8,0],[2.15,0,0]])
print('metal signed volumes',vol(page_points),vol(model_points))
# Opposite signs are repaired by swapping the y and z axes across all ligands,
# but not the organic stereochemistry (rotated subsequently as a rigid body).
# Here the chosen axes have the same handedness as the drawing.

frags=[org,tp,p]
for m,x in zip(frags,[orgxyz,tpxyz,pxyz]):
 c=m.GetConformer()
 for i,pt in enumerate(x):c.SetAtomPosition(i,pt)
# Optimize capped Tp first, allowing its internal angles to settle.
def makeff(m,mmff):
 if mmff:return AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m),confId=0)
 return AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,confId=0)
tpff=makeff(tp,False)
def tp_fun(x):
 xx=x.reshape(-1,3);energy=tpff.CalcEnergy(x.tolist());g=np.array(tpff.CalcGrad(x.tolist())).reshape(-1,3)
 d=xx[nd]-targets;energy+=250*np.sum(d*d);g[nd]+=500*d
 # Put the B-H cap on the closed face of the metal.
 d=xx[0]-np.array([-1.8,-1.8,-1.8]);energy+=20*np.sum(d*d);g[0]+=40*d
 return energy,g.ravel()
r=minimize(tp_fun,tpxyz.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':2500,'ftol':1e-10})
tpxyz=r.x.reshape(-1,3)
print('capped Tp:',r.fun,'B',tpxyz[0],'donors',tpxyz[nd])
np.savez('initial.npz',organic=orgxyz,tp=tpxyz,p=pxyz)
# save molecules with their stereo and forcefield params for the assembly
import pickle
with open('fragments.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump(frags,f)
PY
python build.py

exec(open('build.py').read().split('# save molecules')[0])
# Construct all three pyrazole arms from the correctly outward-facing first.
q=tpxyz.copy()
for k,per in [(1,[2,0,1]),(2,[1,2,0])]:
 for j in range(5):q[1+5*k+j]=tpxyz[1+j][per]
 for j in range(3):q[17+3*k+j]=tpxyz[17+j][per]
q[0]=[-1.8]*3;q[16]=q[0]-1.2/np.sqrt(3)*np.ones(3)
def tfun(x):
 e,g=tp_fun(x);g=g.reshape(-1,3); xx=x.reshape(-1,3)
 for j in [1,6,11,3,8,13]:
  d=np.linalg.norm(xx[j]); d0=3.10 if j in [1,6,11] else 3.16
  e+=150*(d-d0)**2;g[j]+=300*(d-d0)*xx[j]/d
 return e,g.ravel()
r=minimize(tfun,q.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':2500,'ftol':1e-11})
tpxyz=r.x.reshape(-1,3)
print('new Tp',r.fun,'B',tpxyz[0],'donors',tpxyz[nd])
np.savez('initial.npz',organic=orgxyz,tp=tpxyz,p=pxyz)
import pickle
with open('fragments.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump(frags,f)

cat > assemble.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np,pickle
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
frags=pickle.load(open('fragments.pkl','rb')); init=np.load('initial.npz')
ff=[]
for j,m in enumerate(frags):
 if j==1: f=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
 else: f=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m))
 ff.append(f)
starts=[0,25,51,64];stops=[25,51,64,66]
coords=np.concatenate([init['organic'],init['tp'],init['p'],[[0,1.8,0],[0,2.96,0]]])
symbols=[a.GetSymbol() for m in frags for a in m.GetAtoms()]+['N','O']
radii={'H':1.2,'B':1.8,'C':1.7,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'P':1.8}
# All nonbonded pairs from different ligands.
pairs=[];ds=[]
for a in range(4):
 for b in range(a+1,4):
  for i in range(starts[a],stops[a]):
   for j in range(starts[b],stops[b]):
    pairs.append([i,j]);ds.append(.87*(radii[symbols[i]]+radii[symbols[j]]))
pairs=np.array(pairs);ds=np.array(ds)
anchors={27:([-2.2,0,0],250),32:([0,-2.2,0],250),37:([0,0,-2.2],250),51:([0,0,2.5],150),64:([0,1.8,0],300),65:([0,2.96,0],100),25:([-1.8,-1.8,-1.8],20)}
radial=[(26,3.1,150),(31,3.1,150),(36,3.1,150),(28,3.16,150),(33,3.16,150),(38,3.16,150)]+[(i,3.60,100) for i in [52,53,54]]+[(11,2.27,150),(12,2.27,150)]
bonds=[(11,12,1.42,800),(64,65,1.16,800)]
# Repulsion of the metal against ligand atoms, except coordinated atoms.
metal_exclude=[27,32,37,51,64,11,12]
metids=np.array([i for i in range(66) if i not in metal_exclude]);metds=np.array([.82*(1.85+radii[symbols[i]]) for i in metids])
def fun(x):
 q=x.reshape(-1,3);g=np.zeros_like(q);e=0.
 for f,s,t in zip(ff,starts[:3],stops[:3]):
  a=x[3*s:3*t].tolist();e+=f.CalcEnergy(a);g[s:t]+=np.array(f.CalcGrad(a)).reshape(-1,3)
 for i,(pos,k) in anchors.items():
  d=q[i]-pos;e+=k*np.dot(d,d);g[i]+=2*k*d
 # Alkene centroid and equal carbon distance from W.
 d=(q[11]+q[12])/2-np.array([2.15,0,0]);e+=180*np.dot(d,d);g[11]+=180*d;g[12]+=180*d
 for i,d0,k in radial:
  r=np.linalg.norm(q[i]);d=r-d0;e+=k*d*d;g[i]+=2*k*d*q[i]/r
 for i,j,d0,k in bonds:
  v=q[i]-q[j];r=np.linalg.norm(v);d=r-d0;e+=k*d*d;gr=2*k*d*v/r;g[i]+=gr;g[j]-=gr
 vv=q[pairs[:,0]]-q[pairs[:,1]];r2=np.sum(vv*vv,axis=1)
 ee=.05*(ds*ds/r2)**6;e+=np.sum(ee);gg=(-12*ee/r2)[:,None]*vv
 np.add.at(g,pairs[:,0],gg);np.add.at(g,pairs[:,1],-gg)
 vv=q[metids];r2=np.sum(vv*vv,axis=1);ee=.04*(metds*metds/r2)**6;e+=ee.sum();g[metids]+=(-12*ee/r2)[:,None]*vv
 return e,g.ravel()
best=None
for angle in range(0,360,30):
 xyz=coords.copy();xyz[:25]=Rotation.from_euler('x',angle,degrees=True).apply(xyz[:25]-[2.15,0,0])+[2.15,0,0]
 r=minimize(fun,xyz.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':1300,'ftol':2e-9,'gtol':1e-4})
 print(angle,r.fun,r.success,r.nit,flush=True)
 if best is None or r.fun<best.fun:best=r
q=best.x.reshape(-1,3)
np.save('final_coords.npy',q)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write('67\nTpW(NO)(PMe3)(eta2-cis-fused cyanocyclohexene N-methyl lactam); angstrom\n')
 for s,p in zip(symbols+['W'],np.vstack([q,np.zeros(3)])):
  f.write(f'{s:2s} {p[0]: .8f} {p[1]: .8f} {p[2]: .8f}\n')
print('best energy',best.fun)
for j,m in enumerate(frags):
 c=m.GetConformer()
 for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):c.SetAtomPosition(i,q[starts[j]+i])
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(frags[0],replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(frags[0],cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('final stereo',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(frags[0],includeUnassigned=True))
print('coordination',[(i,symbols[i],np.linalg.norm(q[i])) for i in metal_exclude])
print('alkene',np.linalg.norm(q[11]-q[12]))
PY
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python assemble.py

import numpy as np,pickle
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D
q=np.vstack([np.load('final_coords.npy'),np.zeros(3)]);frags=pickle.load(open('fragments.pkl','rb'));syms=[a.GetSymbol() for m in frags for a in m.GetAtoms()]+['N','O','W']
bonds=[]
for st,m in zip([0,25,51],frags):
 for b in m.GetBonds():bonds.append([st+b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),st+b.GetEndAtomIdx()])
bonds.extend([[64,65]]+[[66,j] for j in [27,32,37,51,64,11,12]])
colors={'H':'white','C':'#666666','B':'#ecad68','N':'#3059ea','O':'#ee332d','P':'#eb9b16','W':'#8d45c1'}
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,6))
for k,(elev,azim) in enumerate([(20,30),(15,140)]):
 ax=fig.add_subplot(1,2,k+1,projection='3d')
 for i,j in bonds:
  if syms[i]=='H' or syms[j]=='H':continue
  ax.plot(q[[i,j],0],q[[i,j],1],q[[i,j],2],c='gray',linewidth=2)
 for i,s in enumerate(syms):
  if s=='H':continue
  ax.scatter(*q[i],color=colors[s],s=110 if s=='W' else 60,edgecolor='black')
  ax.text(*q[i],f'{s}{i}',fontsize=8)
 ax.set_box_aspect((1,1,1));ax.view_init(elev,azim);ax.set_axis_off()
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig('model.png',dpi=150)
# Check interfragment minimums and all bonded lengths
for a,(sa,ta) in enumerate([(0,25),(25,51),(51,64),(64,66)]):
 for b,(sb,tb) in enumerate([(0,25),(25,51),(51,64),(64,66)]):
  if b<=a:continue
  d=np.linalg.norm(q[sa:ta,None]-q[None,sb:tb],axis=-1);idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(d),d.shape)
  print('closest fragments',a,b,(sa+idx[0],sb+idx[1]),d[idx])
print('BH',np.linalg.norm(q[25]-q[41]))
# metal behind ring, as drawn by W -> alkene solid wedge.
u=q[12]-q[11];v=q[[2,3,4,10]].mean(0)-(q[11]+q[12])/2;n=np.cross(v,u);n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
print('w-face',np.dot(-(q[11]+q[12])/2,n),'CN face',np.dot(q[1]-q[2],n))
